content: The corpus contains PDFs and webpages collected from web sources in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland at the end of 2018/beginning of 2019. The web sources mostly consist of websites of governments, specialised institutions, translation agencies, and non-profit organisations (92 different domains). The documents cover a range of topics, such as politics (e.g., instructions for voting), health (e.g., what to do in case of pregnancy), and culture (e.g., introduction to art museums).
